text: {"assertions":["A leaked field vulnerability was discovered in platform/logging/redact.go on 2026-04-09 where sensitive values were not being properly masked in log output.","The bug only manifested for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys, making it difficult to detect in standard testing.","The root cause was schema drift between the database migration and the data model.","The undetected redaction failure went unalerted for 83 consecutive days before being caught.","The issue can be reproduced by logging the nested payload fixture.","The fix involved regenerating the model from the migration and pinning the checksum, implemented in PR #1245 on branch fix/leaked-field-1.","This leaked field issue occurred in the same area of code as previous similar vulnerabilities.","Platform-side changes were made to address the vulnerability."]}
